itineraries.title: Five days around the Pontine Islands
itineraries.intro: Rome’s summer islands: Ponza’s chalk cliffs, Palmarola’s wild anchorages and a last night in the Gulf of Naples.

days.note: Board in Gaeta; a first swim under the Montagna Spaccata.
Chiaia di Luna and the Roman grottoes; dinner in the harbour.
A day at anchor off the wildest of the islands; swimming in the coves.
The Roman harbour cut from tufa; a quiet evening ashore.
Cross to Ischia for the thermal springs; disembark in Naples.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Rome to Naples
itineraries.intro: The Ocean Independence classic from Civitavecchia: Ponza, Ischia, Capri, Amalfi and Sorrento, ending in Naples.

days.note: Board at Civitavecchia after a morning in Rome.
Chiaia di Luna, the grottoes and dinner in the harbour.
Thermal springs and the Aragonese castle.
Anchor off Nerano; the cathedral and Ravello.
Views over the Bay of Naples from the cliff-top town.
A morning at anchor; disembark at midday.
